message: I often find myself chuckling at the little moments when I'm just not prepared—like the time I tried to find a flashlight during a power outage and ended up with a collection of mismatched batteries instead! 😂 It's really helpful to have a plan in place, especially for the kiddos. If you're looking for some fun ways to get your family involved in being prepared, check out this great resource that makes it easy and engaging. What’s your favorite way to keep your family ready for anything?
